plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), Mathematics Major (BS) program page (poid=920). Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The recorded total is the exact sum of the itemized requirements at their exercised values, as disclosed below; the program page prints no hour total. The full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan are disclosed in these notes and are not recorded as plan prerequisites. The program lists twelve required core courses plus one elective and prints no hour total and no residency note; the recorded total (48) is the exact sum of the twelve courses' printed Hour(s) values (45) plus the elective exercised at its printed minimum of 3 (the elective is printed at 3-4 hrs, so a 4-hour elective completion totals 49, as printed). Prerequisites disclosed, not recorded, because they name courses outside this plan: MATH 100 requires MATH 025 Elementary Functions and Graphs with a grade of C- or better (MATH 025's own description states it is not included in the major); MATH 107 requires one of MATH 060, MATH 070 or MATH 100; MATH 390's printed prerequisite is MATH 101 and MATH 121 or permission of instructor (the two named courses are recorded; the permission alternative is disclosed here). MATH 107's description states three lectures and a two-hour laboratory per week; no separate lab course or corequisite is printed for it. Also disclosed, not recorded: PHYS 210 requires MATH 070 or MATH 100 (MATH 070 is outside this plan). PHYS 210's printed corequisite is PHYS 210L College Physics I Lab (0 Hour(s)), disclosed here and not placed as a separate course, per the Salem lab precedent. MATH 135's description prints the spelling 'hypthesis' [sic] as 'hypthesis'; the course title and credits are unaffected.

courses.title: Allied Discipline Elective
courses.choice_note: Select one additional course (3-4 hrs) in an allied discipline at the 100 level or above (ACCT, BCHM, BIOL, CHEM, ECON, ENVS, EXER, FINC, PUBH, or PHYS), as printed. The catalog names no specific course for this elective, so no options are listed. Recorded at the printed minimum of 3 Hour(s); a 4-hour completion totals 1 hour more than the recorded total. As printed, a student may petition the program director of mathematics for permission to satisfy this requirement with a course from another discipline not listed.
